sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 79 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: Draft configuration: Compact inner triangular 100 circuit uses the short northwestern hairpin. The closing connector runs opposite its source one-way tag in this configuration; source tags and coordinates remain unchanged, and race-day direction is provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1562.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

notes: Draft route hypothesis: the source cycle is the unique closest nominal-distance match within conservative timing and distance checks. Approximate OSM trace length 3193.6 m. Difference from the supplied layout distance 5.4 m. Course configuration still requires visual review.
